text:
Anya: opened PR to consolidate call-chain + structured-output examples for the migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

Docs-bot: PR opened by Anya - review requested @lucas @emma :eyes:

Kai: quick ask — can we include both Python and TS SDK snippets that show function/tool calling + JSON Schema guardrail example? current PR has pseudocode only.

Lucas: I can add the TS example. Which canonical model should examples target? redwood/fast-serve-v1 or a quantized variant?

Anya: use redwood/fast-serve-v1 in the main examples, add a note about redwood/fast-serve-q8 as a low-cost option. Also include a tiny parser fallback example for malformed JSON.

Ben: also we need to fix links in the sidebar — old path /sdk/function_calling.md -> /sdk/invoke.md. I'll list the redirects in the PR description.

Emma: I'll prep a small follow-up PR that adjusts cross-doc links if you prefer, or we can patch in this PR. :thumbsup:

Kai: assign reviewers @lucas @emma. Checklist: run snippet linter, run examples test, add one structured-output unit test showing schema failure -> parser fallback. Keep examples < 40 lines each.

Lucas: pushed draft TS snippet to the branch. snippet uses this shape:
```
const call = {
  name: "create_issue",
  arguments: { title: "bug: login fail", severity: "high" }
}
```

Anya: perfect. I'll add the JSON Schema and the fallback parsing note. Thanks everyone — aim to merge by EOD tomorrow if reviews are clean.

Emma: noted, will review tomorrow morning. :coffee:
